scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const {execSync}=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){execSync('npm run build --prefix frontend',{stdio:'inherit'}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','public',{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('backend')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','backend/public',{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('backend_fastapi')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist','backend_fastapi/public',{recursive:true});}}else{execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
